x: The race was run over a very flat fast course and was won by a comparative newcomer, Gregory (Walton) from Mitcham's Biscoe.In the team competition we defeated our near rivals Hercules and Mitcham comvincingly.
John was second, closely followed by Manchester & Dist. Lads Club (Gregory) and Mitcham A.C.(K.Smith). This was our best start for a long time and gave every hope for a successful day.
Trevor held his place well for most of the stage and moved past Polytechnic (Beacham) near the end to take 4th position, only to be passed by Gregory (Man DLC) who had run 37 seconds faster.
BLACKPOOL - Fastest Times:--Freary (Bol)21:20 rec.,Hill (Bol)21:23,J. Jackson (NS) 21:49, Gerry North 21:59, Geoff North 22:02, Gregory (Man) 22:13.
Manchester (Gregory) and Hercules/Wimbledon (R.Holt) had closed up to within 30 seconds. At this point our supporters felt more confident of receiving second place than at anytime.
